summary: Feature implemented in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), with 24 new tests in tests/test_progress.py, a docs section in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG bullet linking PR 1759. The diff is insertions only and nothing was committed. Nothing was run: no tests, mypy, or repository code. Open risks: Python 3.6 may fail to instantiate the reader because typing.IO declares mode and name as abstract; the module-level open return-value suppression was omitted on the expectation that mypy accepts it; and no test covers text-mode buffering above 1 being forwarded to the byte handle.
